import { Fragment } from "@shadow-js/web";
import { onMount, useSignal } from "@shadow-js/core";
import { render } from "preact";
import { useRef } from "preact/hooks";
import { signal } from "@preact/signals";

const visits = signal(0);

export function Counter({ start }: { start: number }) {
  const [count, setCount] = useSignal(start);
  const input = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);

  onMount(() => {
    input.current?.focus();
  });

  const bump = () => setCount(count() + 1);

  return (
    <Fragment>
      <button ref={input} onClick={bump}>
        {count()}
      </button>
      <p>{visits.value} visits</p>
    </Fragment>
  );
}

render(<Counter start={1} />, document.body);
